title: 69. How can I change the title of my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How can I change the title of my survey.
short_answer: Open the survey and go to the 'Properties' page. Change your survey's title under 'Basic' section. If you have already published your survey, go to the 'Overview' page and click 'Apply Changes'.
